allow_remote_gui_rpc.description: Allow GUI RPC connections from remote hosts.

no_gpus.description: Do not detect or use GPUs.

no_info_fetch.description: Do not fetch project list or client version info from boinc.berkeley.edu.

skip_cpu_benchmarks.description: Skip running CPU benchmarks on startup.

start_delay.description: Delay starting apps by N seconds.

file_xfer_giveup_period.description: Give up on file transfers after N seconds (0 = use default).

master_fetch_interval.description: Limit the period between project master file download retries (seconds).

sched_retry_delay_min.description: Minimum retry delay for project RPCs (seconds).

sched_retry_delay_max.description: Maximum retry delay for project RPCs (seconds).

pers_retry_delay_min.description: Minimum retry delay for persistent file transfers (seconds).

pers_retry_delay_max.description: Maximum retry delay for persistent file transfers (seconds).

pers_giveup.description: Give-up time for persistent file transfer errors (seconds).

unsigned_apps_ok.description: Allow execution of unsigned applications (for testing only).

redirect_io.description: Redirect stdout and stderr to log files (stdoutdae.txt, stderrdae.txt).

allow_multiple_clients.description: Allow more than one client instance per host.

abort_jobs_on_exit.description: Abort and report running tasks when client exits.

no_priority_change.description: Do not adjust application process priority.

no_gui_rpc.description: Do not create GUI RPC socket; disable remote control.

fetch_minimal_work.description: Fetch only 1 task per device at a time.

check_all_logins.description: Include remote logins in idle detection.

projects.description: List of projects to attach to at startup. Each item must contain 'url' and 'authenticator'.

extra_options.description: List of additional command-line-like directives not covered above. Each item is a string to append as-is.
